steps.name: The Noble of the Slums (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lashur] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, obtain a <Mysterious Fragment>, then turn in the quest to [Lashur] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.text: (At the Siren Fountain, a famous sight in Glaston's central plaza, residents and apparent visitors from other regions admire the fountain.)
(Someone throws a coin into the fountain and makes a wish. Another person sees this and follows suit, as though spellbound.)
Please let me meet someone nice this year...
I hope my mother stays healthy...
Please let me earn lots of Ely...
(Coins carrying people's heartfelt wishes sparkle beautifully in the sunlight beneath the water.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful. I should make a wish too.
(Just then, a man wearing accessories so dazzling he looks as though he has swallowed gold appears before the Siren Fountain.)
(The people making wishes step back, as though accustomed to this.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You're all here to make wishes, right? I'll pay the Siren, so just make your wishes. Don't waste your own money. All right? Hahaha!
(Lashur takes gold coins from his pouch and tosses them one by one into the fountain, as though feeding birds in the plaza.)
(Each time, people make wishes and thank Lashur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lashur. It's been a while since we met in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Here, make a wish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I wish for...?)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Can't decide what to wish for? Then wish for everything that's on your mind.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If one gold coin buys one wish, how many coins do your wishes need?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Will this be enough?
(Lashur turns his coin pouch upside down and empties it into the fountain.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I don't know what your situation is, and I don't particularly care, but it'll all work out. I, Lashur, am wishing for you, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern, but aren't you spending too much?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha, money? It's always here today, here tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it 'here today, gone tomorrow'...?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Who knows? I've never been without it. Hahaha. Anyway, don't underestimate yourself. You're someone extraordinary.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The talk of Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: A little while ago, rumors began spreading that a hero from another continent would visit the slums of LaChouette.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: LaChouette is a slum? I only arrived in Glaston today... Wait, more to the point, hardly anyone should know I was coming.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Rumors in Glaston are like smoke. People create them out of nothing, spread them everywhere, and they seep into everyone's lives...

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: A surprising amount of information finds its way to Richberry. Some of it might interest you. What do you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Share a little of what you have with me, and I might tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I hear mysterious fragments are occasionally found in places that strong people like you visit. I don't need many. Just twenty.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: They're only for my collection. I won't use them for anything else, so don't worry. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I do need information. I'll bring him the fragments...)

steps.name: The Noble of the Slums (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lashur] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then turn in the quest to [Manuel] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」.

lines.text: (Lashur examines the fragments he received from %s and gives a small smile.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: So these are the famous fragments. Rare, certainly, but I doubt I can do anything with them. They'll have to serve as collector's pieces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of collection?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I collect rare stones and things. I've grown tired of collecting gold nuggets.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Now you look tired of me too. Hahaha. Then, as promised, here's some worthwhile information.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The head of House Diamont, a family honored for helping found the nation, visited LaChouette again today. That should do, yes?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You look completely lost. I suppose a noble lord visiting the slums doesn't strike you as a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Couldn't he just be visiting?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Nobles connected to the council usually avoid anything involving the lower classes. Appearing in the slums is extremely unusual.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well, members of the imperial family or His Majesty might visit occasionally.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If a noble lord like that comes to the slums, something must be happening, whether good or bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Understand now? That's why I called it worthwhile information. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I'm a little curious myself, but I don't want to get deeply involved. What good ever comes of entangling yourself with nobles?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: It seems more useful to someone like you, with connections all over the place, than to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha. I'll leave it to you to decide what to do with this information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I've rewarded you generously, just as I promised before. See you later, my friend.
(Lashur pats %s on the shoulder and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...He really is an unusual person... I should go back to LaChouette Street for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh. Where have I heard the name Diamont before...?

steps.name: The Noble of the Slums (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Manuel] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」, then obtain <Detective K's Case Notes>, a <Paper Rose>, and a <Target Sheet> in 「Theater Eugamon」. Then turn in the quest to [Manuel] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」.

lines.text: (In a quiet alley in LaChouette, known as the slums, a middle-aged man whose bearing seems out of place stands looking down the alley.)
(Everyone seems to recognize him. They bow in greeting and hurry past.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That must be the person Lashur mentioned...)
(At that moment, the middle-aged man's eyes meet %s's. He raises a hand and beckons.)
You there. Come here.
Don't pretend you didn't notice. You were watching me.
(The man looks %s over and speaks cautiously.)
...Judging by your appearance, I know who you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know me?
Glaston is sensitive to rumors. It would be absurd not to recognize the person at the center of them.
You are the hero who saved Eastland from the threat of evil... %s... An important figure whom the council, however, finds rather hard to like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to know who you are as well.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: My introduction is overdue. I am Manuel, head of House Diamont.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I do not know what brings you to Glaston, but pass through quietly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know what I intend to do, to say that? I can at least tell you don't think highly of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: More to the point, I would like to know why you are here. I hear you come here almost every day. What are you trying to do?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Hush. There are many ears around. So you have investigated that much...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Hmm... If you want to hear my story... Do you happen to know Gentleman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gentleman? Oh, Gentleman!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think the doll I saw at the Eugamon Theater was called Gentleman...)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Bring me anything you know about Gentleman. Then I will tell you why I am here.

steps.name: The Noble of the Slums (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Manuel] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」, then turn in the quest to [Lashur] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Detective K's case records, a paper rose, a target... All materials that were not admitted as evidence. I will not ask where you found them.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Once, there was a man who called himself Mr. Demonic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're telling me right away?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: You have shown your sincerity. I am simply answering.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Long ago, I had a friend in a position similar to mine. He was timid, but he dreamed of the theater and was always writing plays.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: But after his father passed away, he could no longer do anything he wished.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: He was practically forced to become head of his house, and it seems the strain was immense. At the time, all I wanted was to help my friend.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Perhaps it was coincidence, but I heard of a mage who offered counsel to troubled nobles. So I recommended that he consult the mage...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Sigh... It is my responsibility. He changed after meeting that mage...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I still remember his words. With the right power, he could do whatever he wished.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I did not understand what he meant at first, but his later actions made it clear.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: That he was attacking people in the streets every night... That he had become [Gentleman], the murderer who terrorized Glaston...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: One rainy night, he said it would be the last time, bid me farewell, and left. Afterward, an order of knights pursued him as far as LaChouette...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I do not know what became of him or the knights. They all vanished without a trace. The tale became a ghost story, and decades passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you've started visiting this place recently, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I heard that someone matching his description had appeared in LaChouette.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: When rumors are untrue, they tend to grow. So I came to see for myself, but I learned nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Couldn't you leave that to the knights?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Perhaps I simply want to ease the burden on my heart... To find even a clue that might help catch a monstrous criminal...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Does that satisfy you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, yes...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: You seem to want something more. But there are things I cannot discuss, so we will stop here for now.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: And I offer my thanks for helping my son.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I met your son, Manuel? Oh, Alexis...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: The fool who sold our family's land and fled to Invernel is my son.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I haven't done anything to help Alexis...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: If you helped the Order in Highland, that also means you helped my son...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even people in Glaston have heard about that...)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Did my son happen to mention me? That I am assisting the council...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: In any case, this conversation ends here. I would appreciate your keeping it from others.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This conversation...? I get the feeling he'll have more to say later...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's return to the plaza for now. If Lashur is there, I'll try talking to him some more...)
(Returning to the plaza, %s spots Lashur once again holding a pouch of gold coins and scattering them into the fountain.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Lashur, donations for the plaza and its residents are welcome, but performances like this cause problems!!

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Even with every maintenance worker out here, collecting them is hard work!!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahahaha! When I asked last time, you said it was allowed.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: We didn't know you meant this many!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: All right. I'll think of another way, then.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: When will we ever finish carrying this away? I'd better call everyone from the office...

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha, hang in there.
(Lashur pats Moran on the back as he leaves, then notices someone watching him from behind.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: It's you. Was the information any use?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still not sure.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: That sounds like you're saying I need to gather some more information.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Did I hit the mark? Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you happen to have any other information?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well...
(Lashur chuckles and pats %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Information depends on the time, the place, and the person. This doesn't seem to be the right moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I like how quickly you accept things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Then I'll see you later. I'm rather busy.
(After Lashur leaves, Moran appears at the fountain with his coworkers.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: The gold coins Lashur scattered alone must be worth about ten billion Ely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (However I look at it, Lashur really is an unusual person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Anyway, I've learned something important. I should sort through it.)
